title: QOL for MC 1.0
body:
**NOT ACTUALLY FOR RISUGAMI'S MODLOADER! THIS IS A JAR MOD.**

This is a mod for Minecraft version 1.0.0. It backports some nice user experience changes that were made later in Minecraft's lifetime:
- A sprint key (defaulting to Left Control) and ability to rebind it.
- Holding right click and dragging in an inventory while holding an item will spread out one of the item each across multiple slots.

It also adds some non-vanilla QOL features:
- Zoom keybind and zoom amount option

The classes provided in this .zip file _must be added to Minecraft.jar_. This means the mod is incompatible with any other mods for this version that override those same class files, and most likely incompatible with any modloaders.

Source code is available in the form of a patch file for use with RetroMCP. This is attached to the release version of the mod.
